## Status legend

- **draft** — initial design, actively being written
- **accepted** — design agreed upon, ready for implementation
- **rejected** — the idea was not accepted; the entry lives in archive/ with its reason
- **superseded** — replaced by a newer enhancement; the entry lives in archive/ with `superseded_by` naming the successor
